chunks: "The beginning time of the Jumuʿah prayer is from when the sun declines until an hour passes, so preserve it carefully, for the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"No servant asks Allah, Mighty and Majestic, for any good during it except that He gives it to him."

key_terms.أَوَّلُ: the beginning or earliest part of a time
key_terms.تَزُولُ: declines from the zenith; the sun passes midday
key_terms.خَيْرًا: good, benefit, or blessing sought from Allah
key_terms.فَحَافِظْ: guard it carefully; observe it with care
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the designated time for an act of worship

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Jumuʿah prayer begin, and what is the virtue of making du'a then?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies the beginning of the time of Jumuʿah prayer as the moment of zawal and extends it until an hour has passed. It also highlights the virtue of that time, teaching that supplication for good made then is granted by Allah.
